extracted.intended_audience: general readers, students, journalists, and researchers interested in cybersecurity incidents and media/industry responses
extracted.subtask_description: A Wikipedia encyclopedic summary of the November 2014 Sony Pictures Entertainment hack, covering the attack timeline, leaked information, alleged perpetrators, responses from government and industry, legal repercussions, and public discussion. Intended as a factual case study of a major corporate cyberattack and its aftermath.
